text.what: OpenStreetMap's highway=construction, in the box: 101 ways, 14.6 km. The longest: unnamed 0.8 km, unnamed 0.8 km, unnamed 0.63 km, unnamed 0.33 km, unnamed 0.33 km, unnamed 0.29 km. A volunteer tag, dated by the last person who looked; the plans page has what the departments say.
text.story: *Inference —* the map and the ministry disagree on what is being built, and both are right on the day they were written. The interchanges on the outer ring are on one list; the lane behind a housing estate is on the other.
